prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Design Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Select a archetype or customize your pet's personality and appearance live.", "Select Pet Archetype"]
1: ["Next: Learn Pet Controls", "How to Interact With Your Pet", "Right-click your pet for commands, drag to reposition on screen, or press Alt+P to toggle visibility.", "Try dragging your pet across your screen", "Right-click to open pet action menu", "Got It, Start Playing!"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now so your pet's memory, items, and settings are safe across all your devices.", "Your pet is already created and will attach automatically."]
3: ["Shape Your Pet's Personality", "While your pet renders in the background, pick three traits to define its behavior.", "Select Trait: Playful vs Calm", "Pet rendering progress: 65%"]
4: ["Your Pet Is Ready for Your Desktop!", "Verify screen permissions below so your pet can roam freely over your open windows.", "Allow Desktop Overlay Permission", "Test Pet Visibility Now"]
5: ["Use well-lit, front-facing photos for best rendering accuracy.", "Tip: Avoid blurry or shadowy photos to prevent AI generation errors."]
6: ["Your pet is being drawn frame-by-frame. You can safely minimize this window."]
7: ["Secure Your Pet Data", "Signing in ensures your pet stays with you even if you reinstall or switch computers.", "Existing pet choices are automatically preserved during login."]
8: ["How Would You Like to Pick Your Pet?", "Choose a fast preset pet or create a custom pet from your own photos.", "Quick Preset Pet (Instant)", "Custom AI Pet (Personalized)"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to officially finalize adoption!", "Official Companion Badge Unlocked!", "Enter Pet Name"]
